checkpoint_selection.criterion: minimum disjoint heldout weighted negative log likelihood

decision.interpretation: A pass nominates replication and interval calibration; it does not establish exact target-weight recovery or posterior correctness.

nonclaims: canary thresholds are calibration hypotheses, not promoted defaults
training loss or heldout NLL alone does not establish posterior correctness
analytic-target success does not establish SSL-LSTM validity
research_question: Does defensive weighted forward-KL learn global target geometry more faithfully than matched reverse KL on an analytic target?
